### Hallador Energy Company Schedules Third Quarter 2026 Conference Call for November 9, 2026 at 5:00 p.m. ET


October 26, 2026


TERRE HAUTE, Ind., Oct. 26, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Hallador Energy Company (Nasdaq: HNRG) (“Hallador” or the “Company”), will host a conference call on Monday, November 9, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. Eastern time to discuss its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. The Company’s results will be reported in a press release prior to the call.


Hallador’s management will host the conference call, followed by a question-and-answer period. Interested parties may submit questions prior to the call by emailing the Company’s investor relations team, Elevate IR, at[HNRG@elevate-ir.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=M7QLFgsWmnWdsdY1xOqUSTVlMt7nlJRmblzHOG-MBG1nL-BOGHc_-dvUJ6TUhBe6CUBplY4eu1y7tmM-QNQojLFAgjTt3tl8h4QcOdbFOcM=) .


**Date:** Monday, November 9, 2026
**Time:** 5:00 p.m. Eastern time
**Dial-in registration link:**[here](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=GsjLrQ0wqdamImCaAzOQ0AjD_pj7m-jNq1Y9E2PIMC5uW_I8ZKYMxCUAOcgqPlf-AcBHoBs0iQAvpqw43XFoZyun7QEd5o2HrUSqg9PNUN7Wn4MToAdEB3uSewIxn-YZoeIZ9Z1_5s7pqXtcZtyk4i_RRKyc85zrC7hX1qTTbBQ=)
**Live webcast registration link:**[here](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=GsjLrQ0wqdamImCaAzOQ0LLpMMEGmdulsbXuUyYaLq8E8mDsL38GBWGDqbFdftyekc6_pjyedap61XnHLxwptbMrKJZbkpkzw1cutzPKL2s=)


The conference call will also be broadcast live and available for replay in the investor relations section of the Company’s website at[www.halladorenergy.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=qnZ5J0AfHGNqCPvnuFeYXaa6cwbXq_AZvWFzjAuHoOI5jw3cbKmm0VQEv2thlgSdpP9pyzQM34F625DF5NCeqZW7l_uWsFsNMaXZDgAbCx8=) .


**About Hallador Energy Company**


Hallador Energy Company (Nasdaq: HNRG) is a vertically-integrated Independent Power Producer (IPP) based in Terre Haute, Indiana. The Company has two core businesses: Hallador Power Company, LLC, which produces electricity and provides accredited capacity at its one-Gigawatt (GW) Merom Generating Station, and Sunrise Coal, LLC, which produces and supplies fuel to the Merom Generating Station and other companies. To learn more about Hallador, visit the Company’s website at[www.halladorenergy.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=qnZ5J0AfHGNqCPvnuFeYXaa6cwbXq_AZvWFzjAuHoOI7ElmOBwWua-RcRetiZ-KBahAInpTxKicB9nrTUTgiJDTrW1fhazYYMer6o2AZJdc=) .
